verdicts.reason: Both use the same cramped leaderboard layout. The legal text is set at an unreadable size and jammed into a block right beside the CTA, the subcopy sits against the top and right edges, the bottle is shrunk until its label can't be read, and the tilted ribbon crowds the logo. A also has a broken wordmark: it reads 'SOLST CE' with a gap under the sun icon. B's 'SOLSTICE' is intact, so B wins narrowly.
